params.why: Seq 7 requires "whatever replaces the agent's ear" to catch scams at least as well as the phone did, and seq 30 names the attacker we design against as the person coaching the customer in real time — this is the in-app equivalent of the agent slowing down and asking why, surfaced as a decision the customer has to answer before the payment goes.

props.title: Has someone told you to make this payment?
props.body: If someone contacted you out of the blue and asked you to move money urgently — even someone claiming to be your bank, the police, or a company you trust — stop. We will never ask you to move money to keep it safe.
props.confirmLabel: No, I set this up myself
